name: Meghalaya State Data Centre (MSDC), NIC Building Shillong
developer: Department of Information Technology, Government of Meghalaya / Meghalaya Information Technology Society
notes: Official DIT page says the MSDC was inaugurated on 17 August 2011; facility is about 1,800 sq ft on the 2nd floor of the NIC Building, connected to MSWAN and operated 24x7 for government e-governance hosting. DIT news archive shows continuing tenders and maintenance notices for the same State Data Centre through 2025.

name: New Meghalaya State Data Centre at ICCC Building, Umsawli, New Shillong
developer: Department of Information Technology, Government of Meghalaya / Meghalaya Information Technology Society
notes: Official DIT news archive dated 7 June 2025 invited online bids for design, site preparation, supply, installation, configuration, testing, training, setup, operations and maintenance of MSDC at ICCC Building, Umsawli, New Shillong. TCIL EOI dated 23 June 2025 references client tender MITS/2025/2-B for the same work; tender aggregator details mention 120 kVA UPS, 250 kVA DG set, racks, storage and physical/IT infrastructure but no MW capacity.
